questions.q: Identify the error: “Each of the nurses have been given a new uniform.”
questions.why: 'Each of' takes a singular verb: 'has been given'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “Between you and ____, the plan is risky.”
questions.why: A preposition takes the object form 'me'. GPSC-style practice item.
Standard spelling 'benefited' (single t). GPSC CBRT, Feb 2024.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “I wish I ____ more attention in class last year.”
questions.why: A wish about the past takes the past perfect. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In the sentence “She is the doctor whose advice saved my father,” the clause “whose advice saved my father” is a:
questions.why: 'Whose' is a relative pronoun; the clause qualifies 'doctor'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “garrulous”:
questions.why: 'Garrulous' means excessively talkative; 'taciturn' means habitually silent. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “You have never been to Goa, ____?”
questions.why: 'Never' makes the statement negative, so the tag is positive. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: Not only did he finish the report, but he also presented it.
Not only he did finish the report, but also he presented it.
Not only he finished the report, but he also presented it.
Not only did he finished the report, but he also presented it.
questions.why: 'Not only' at the start: did + subject + base verb. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “People once believed that the earth was flat.”
opts: The earth was once believed to be flat.
The earth is once believed to be flat.
The earth once believed to be flat.
The earth was once believed being flat.
questions.why: Past 'believed' becomes 'was believed' with an infinitive. Like GPSC CBRT, May 2026.

questions.q: Identify the error: “Little did he realised the danger until it was too late.”
questions.why: After 'did' the main verb is in the base form: 'realise'. GPSC-style practice item.
